data.one_liner: Mocks for Google Sign In to write unit tests for authentication.
data.what_it_does: Provides a mock implementation of Google Sign In for unit testing Dart and Flutter applications. It enables simulating successful sign-ins, user cancellations, and exceptions without requiring actual platform integrations.
use_when: You are writing unit tests that involve Google Sign In.
You want to test authentication flows and cancellation states locally.
avoid_when: You are building production authentication features in your application.
strengths: Easy to set up and use in unit tests alongside firebase_auth_mocks.
Allows simulation of canceled sign-ins and custom exceptions.
weaknesses: Limited only to mocking Google Sign In functionality for testing.
